from rcb_hb import Session

def rollout(period,ha,ka,aa,lean,sign=1,torso_fb=0., ramp=20):
 s.reset(); metrics=[]
 for t in range(1000):
  phase=2*np.pi*t/period
  rampf=min(1,t/max(1,ramp))
  q=base.copy()
  for side,offset in ((0,0),(5,np.pi)):
   p=phase+offset
   # left hip, knee, ankle; alternating flexed swing and extended support
   sw=max(0.,np.sin(p))
   q[side+2]+=sign*ha*np.sin(p)*rampf
   q[side+3]+=ka*sw*rampf
   q[side+4]-=sign*.35*ha*np.sin(p)*rampf + aa*sw*rampf
  q[10]=lean

  # minimal feedback from trunk pitch

  _,_,done=s.step(action)

   fz=np.array([d.site_xpos[s.low.model.site(n).id][2] for n in ('left_foot','right_foot')])

We present [HumanoidBench](https://sferrazza.cc/humanoidbench_site/), a simulated humanoid robot benchmark consisting of $15$ whole-body manipulation and $12$ locomotion tasks. This repo contains the code for environments and training.
